warnings: analytics/order-creation.md — No authorization policy is supplied for warehouse_operator.

test_cases.title: Sales manager creates an order through the orders endpoint
preconditions: A valid sales_manager account is available.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders with the valid order request payload.

test_cases.expected_outcome: A valid sales_manager order-creation request is accepted with HTTP 201 CREATED.

test_cases.title: Create an order with the minimum supported quantity
preconditions: A caller authorized to create orders is available.
test_data: An otherwise valid order request payload with quantity set to integer 1.

steps.action: Authenticate as a caller authorized to create orders.
Send POST /api/v1/orders with quantity set to integer 1.
steps.expected_result: The request is accepted because quantity 1 is within the inclusive supported range.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 1 is accepted as the inclusive lower boundary.

test_cases.title: Create an order with the maximum supported quantity
preconditions: A caller authorized to create orders is available.
test_data: An otherwise valid order request payload with quantity set to integer 100.

steps.action: Authenticate as a caller authorized to create orders.
Send POST /api/v1/orders with quantity set to integer 100.
steps.expected_result: The request is accepted because quantity 100 is within the inclusive supported range.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 100 is accepted as the inclusive upper boundary.

test_cases.title: Reject order creation with quantity below the minimum boundary
preconditions: A caller authorized to create orders is available.
test_data: An otherwise valid order request payload with quantity set to integer 0.

steps.action: Authenticate as a caller authorized to create orders.
Send POST /api/v1/orders with quantity set to integer 0.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 0 is rejected with HTTP 422 QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Reject order creation with quantity above the maximum boundary
preconditions: A caller authorized to create orders is available.
test_data: An otherwise valid order request payload with quantity set to integer 101.

steps.action: Authenticate as a caller authorized to create orders.
Send POST /api/v1/orders with quantity set to integer 101.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 101 is rejected with HTTP 422 QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Deny a viewer attempting to create an order
preconditions: A valid viewer account is available.
test_data: An otherwise valid order request payload.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders with the otherwise valid order request payload.

test_cases.expected_outcome: A viewer is denied order creation with HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN.
